title: centaurium arizonicum
intro: Centaurium arizonicum, commonly known as Arizona centaury or Arizona centaury flower, is a perennial plant native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include promoting health benefits such as soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Centaurium arizonicum are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, improve sleep quality, and exhibit antibacterial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
